---


To stage `app/(admin)/dashboard/layout.tsx`, run:

```bash
git add "app/(admin)/dashboard/layout.tsx"
```

The quotes are needed because of the parentheses in the path.

Alternatively, you can:
- Stage all files: `git add .`
- Stage all files in the admin directory: `git add "app/(admin)/"`
- Stage multiple specific files: `git add file1 file2 file3`
